prompt:
The same Berlin corner. The young man in the navy blue polo shirt and beige
chinos stands on the grey pavement slabs close to the granite kerb, facing
the crossing, seen from behind and slightly to the side. Ahead of him stands a pedestrian traffic light on a bare grey pole, its
black housing holding two round lenses, the upper one lit and glowing an
even plain red. The pale cream facade
and the black parked bicycles behind. Medium wide, vertical frame, daylight,
overcast and flat.
